paragraphs.source_en: No sooner had Torii Suneemon departed than the allied forces of Tokugawa Ieyasu and Oda Nobunaga set out from Okazaki. At noon on the eighteenth, the army passed through Ushikubo, reached Shitaragahara, and immediately made camp. Nobunaga encamped on Mount Gokurakuji, while Ieyasu pitched camp on Mount Chausu. The two armies then decided to hold one final council.
